question: Should the bundled Policy plugin permanently own authored message-routing conformance probes and their associated policy/attestation contract?
rationale: The patch is intentionally opt-in and uses the existing Policy boundary, but it adds a new durable configuration vocabulary whose supported matching semantics and maintenance commitment require maintainer product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the Policy-plugin scope
options.body: Accept the bounded opt-in Policy contract, require inspectable runtime proof, and continue normal review without changing core routing behavior.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Retain only structural checks or a smaller supported probe vocabulary before committing to the broader route-resolution policy surface.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Keep the paired issue open for future product direction and do not merge a new Policy configuration contract now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Policy-plugin scope
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded opt-in Policy contract, require inspectable runtime proof, and continue normal review without changing core routing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the paired proposal and implementation, though a repository owner must make the product decision.
